# Sweepr

> Sweepr is an ultra-lightweight, memory-safe desktop and mobile cleaner built in Rust and Tauri. It reclaims storage space, optimizes RAM, wipes leftover uninstalled app files, and provides DoD 5220.22-M military-grade file shredding with zero bloatware or background telemetry daemons.

## Architecture & Platform Support
- Desktop App: Built in Rust + Tauri (<15MB installer size). Supported on Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS, and Linux.
- Mobile App: Android & iOS companion cleaner with unified licensing.
- Core Modules: DeepClean (browser & system cache cleaner), Optimization (RAM purge & startup optimizer), Uninstaller (residual file & registry cleaner), Utilities (duplicate file finder & multi-pass file shredder).

## Pricing & Licensing
- Free Tier: Unlimited basic temporary file scanning and cleanup.
- Pro Trial: £1.99 for 7 days of full Pro access across 3 PCs and 2 mobile devices.
- Monthly Pro: £9.99/month (cancel anytime in 1 click).
- Annual Pro: £49.99/year (58% savings).
- Guarantee: 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Key Differentiators vs Legacy Cleaners (CCleaner, Avast)
- No background adware or telemetry daemons.
- Under 15MB installer vs 100MB+ legacy bloatware.
- Memory-safe Rust engine for high-speed scanning and deletion.
- Exact file paths and byte sizes shown before anything is deleted.
- Single license covers 3 Desktop PCs + 2 Mobile devices.
